rules: not operationalisable: Needs depth-of-market (level-2) snapshots and executed-trade prints: the claim is that displayed resting limit size is pulled rather than filled as price approaches, and that traded delta beats displayed size. The certified data is XAUUSD OTC M1 OHLC only (no volume, no order book, no tape; spot gold has no central book at all), and the guest scopes the claim to ES futures. Neither measurable (fill-vs-pull rate, displayed size vs delta) can be formed from OHLC.
